description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'LoanBusinessEvent' that extends 'AbstractBusinessEvent' with a generic type 'Loan'. It belongs to the package 'org.apache.fineract.infrastructure.event.business.domain.loan', indicating it is part of the loan-related business event infrastructure within the Apache Fineract project. The class provides functionality to categorize the event as related to a 'Loan' and to retrieve the aggregate root ID from the associated 'Loan' object.
